MLYNARMOD-RANGER_SWORDSMANSHIP.title: Strike
MLYNARMOD-SELF_CONTAINED.title: Defend
MLYNARMOD-KNIGHT_SWORDSMANSHIP.title: Knight Swordsmanship
MLYNARMOD-KNIGHT_SWORDSMANSHIP.descripti: Draw 2 cards, then discard 1. If Sheathed, gain {Poise} Poise.
MLYNARMOD-UNVOICED_FURY.title: Unvoiced Fury
MLYNARMOD-UNVOICED_FURY.description: Draw the sword (1 turn). Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MLYNARMOD-THIS_SWORD_ONLY.title: This Sword Only
MLYNARMOD-THIS_SWORD_ONLY.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If Sheathed, gain {Poise} Poise.
MLYNARMOD-IT_RAINED.title: It Rained
MLYNARMOD-IT_RAINED.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies {Hits} times.
MLYNARMOD-YELLOW_SAND.title: Yellow Sand
MLYNARMOD-YELLOW_SAND.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. Discard 1 card, then draw 1 card.
MLYNARMOD-OLD_BRANCH.title: Old Branch
MLYNARMOD-OLD_BRANCH.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to a random enemy 3 times.
MLYNARMOD-OBLIQUE_CUT.title: Oblique Cut
MLYNARMOD-OBLIQUE_CUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target has Block, deal {Bonus} damage.
MLYNARMOD-SWORD_FLOURISH.title: Sword Flourish
MLYNARMOD-KEEP_TO_ONESELF.title: Keep to Oneself
MLYNARMOD-OFFICIAL_BUSINESS.title: Official Business
MLYNARMOD-USELESS_HABIT.title: Useless Habit
MLYNARMOD-USELESS_HABIT.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. At the end of this turn, if you played no Attack, gain {Poise} Poise.
MLYNARMOD-OUTSIDE_THE_CITY.title: Outside the City
MLYNARMOD-UNRESOLVED_SORROW.title: Unresolved Sorrow
MLYNARMOD-UNRESOLVED_SORROW.description: Draw the sword (1 turn). Deal {Damage:diff()} damage twice, then sheathe. This sheathe does not clear Poise.
MLYNARMOD-IF_ROTTEN.title: If Rotten
MLYNARMOD-IF_ROTTEN.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. If the target is an Elite or Boss, gain {Poise} Poise.
MLYNARMOD-WHIRLING_CUT.title: Whirling Cut
MLYNARMOD-WHIRLING_CUT.description: Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies. If the sword is drawn, do it again.
MLYNARMOD-SHEATHE_CARD.title: Sheathe
MLYNARMOD-SHEATHE_CARD.description: If the sword is drawn, sheathe it. Otherwise, gain {Block:diff()} Block.
MLYNARMOD-UNFINISHED_WORK.title: Unfinished Work
MLYNARMOD-DRAW_MARGARET.title: Draw, Margaret
MLYNARMOD-DRAW_MARGARET.description: Gain {Vigor} Vigor. At the end of this turn, if you played no Attack, take {Self} damage.
MLYNARMOD-FAMILY_LETTER.title: Family Letter
MLYNARMOD-FAMILY_LETTER.description: Scry {Scry}. You may put 1 card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile.
MLYNARMOD-ONE_PAPER.title: One Paper
MLYNARMOD-LONG_ROAD.title: Long Road
MLYNARMOD-LONG_ROAD.description: Gain {Poise} Poise. If this card is still in your hand at end of turn, gain {Hold} Poise.
MLYNARMOD-PERSISTS_ANYWAY.title: Persists Anyway
MLYNARMOD-PERSISTS_ANYWAY.description: Draw {Cards} cards. Gain 1 Energy next turn. Take {Self} damage at the end of this turn.
MLYNARMOD-WANDERER_CARD.title: Wanderer
MLYNARMOD-WANDERER_CARD.description: Your attacks deal +{Dmg} damage. If there are at least 3 enemies, they deal +{Crowd} instead, and you take {Red} less damage.
MLYNARMOD-INDIFFERENT_CARD.title: Indifferent
MLYNARMOD-LIGHTLESS_KNIGHT.title: Lightless Knight
MLYNARMOD-LIGHTLESS_KNIGHT.description: Can only be played while Sheathed. Deal {Damage:diff()} damage. This damage is not increased by Poise. Gain {Poise} Poise.
MLYNARMOD-UNLIT_GLORY.title: Unlit Glory
MLYNARMOD-UNLIT_GLORY.description: Draw the sword (2 turns). Deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies twice, then {True} true damage. Cannot be played while the sword is drawn.
MLYNARMOD-TITLE_OF_GRAND_KNIGHT.title: Title of the Grand Knight
MLYNARMOD-OBSCURE_WANDERER_CARD.title: Obscure Wanderer
MLYNARMOD-OBSCURE_WANDERER_CARD.descript: Scry {Scry}. Gain 1 Poise for each card you discard. You may put 1 card from your discard pile on top of your draw pile.
MLYNARMOD-LETTER_OPENER.title: Letter Opener
MLYNARMOD-LETTER_OPENER.description: Choose: gain {Poise} Poise; OR Exhaust 1 card in hand and Upgrade another.
MLYNARMOD-VAST_ROAR.title: Vast Roar
MLYNARMOD-VAST_ROAR.description: Gain {Block:diff()} Block. For the rest of combat, while Sheathed, whenever you take attack damage, deal {Thorns} true damage to the source.
MLYNARMOD-NEARL_LONG_NIGHT.title: Nearl, the Long Night
MLYNARMOD-NEARL_LONG_NIGHT.description: If the sword is drawn: deal {Damage:diff()} damage to ALL enemies and gain {Block:diff()} Block. If Sheathed: gain {SheathBlock} Block, gain {Poise} Poise, and you cannot draw the sword this turn.
MLYNARMOD-MAN_IN_THE_SHEATH_CARD.title: Man in the Sheath
MLYNARMOD-MAN_IN_THE_SHEATH_CARD.descrip: At the start of each turn, gain {Poise} Poise.
MLYNARMOD-FEAR_NO_DARK_CARD.title: Fear No Dark
MLYNARMOD-GOLDEN_WRATH_CARD.title: Golden Wrath
MLYNARMOD-GOLDEN_WRATH_CARD.description: While Sheathed, each Attack applies Wrath equal to its damage. When you draw the sword, Wrath on all enemies deals that much true damage, then is removed.
